title: Two Royals, One Leap
setup: Black's king on d6 and queen on a5 are two squares apart, and your knight on b2 has not touched either of them yet.
hint: Work backward from the targets: which squares attack the king, and which of those also attacks the queen?
explanation:
## The Idea

A knight's check cannot be blocked, and the piece it attacks can almost never take it back. So one knight move that hits the king and the queen together wins the queen.

{{Nc4+}} touches d6 and a5 at once. The check has to be answered first, no king move reaches a5 to defend the queen, and after {{Kc5}} the knight collects it with {{Nxa5}}.

Two targets, one move, and Black only ever gets to save one.
